transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Well... I'm just here because my husband wanted me to come. It's about the house. For almost two years now, I just know the contractor we hired is... well, he's working with some of the neighbors on our block. They're trying to cheat us. They're keeping my kitchen half-finished and wrong on purpose. My husband keeps showing me receipts and telling me their excuses, but... I know what's really going on.
Have you been hearing voices when no one else is around?
No. I don't... I don't hear anything like that. Just the normal sounds around the house.
Has anything happened that makes you believe the contractor and your neighbors can do things to you that would be impossible for ordinary people to do?

Impossible? ...No. I don't really know why you'd ask that. 

They aren't doing magic or anything. They're just... people. They just talk to each other and mess with the schedules and the materials. Nothing... impossible. Just sneaky.
Have there been times when you felt unusually energized and needed much less sleep than usual?
No. I sleep fine. I don't get... unusually energized. I'm just normal.
Have you had a period of at least two weeks when you felt depressed most of the day, nearly every day?
No... I don't think so. I haven't felt depressed like that. Just... regular days, really.
Have you ever felt that thoughts were being put into your mind by someone else?
No... I don't know what you mean by that. My thoughts are just mine. Nobody is putting them there.
Has anyone told you that your speech is hard to follow or that you jump from one idea to another in a way that doesn’t make sense to them?
No... nobody has ever said that to me. People understand what I'm saying just fine. I just... I talk normally.
Aside from this problem with the contractor and neighbors, have you been functioning normally in your daily life?

Yes, I... everything else is fine. Outside of dealing with all that, I still go to my church gatherings. And my book club. I keep up with my household routines and family plans just... just the way I usually do. Everything else is normal.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient describes a fixed, non-bizarre persecutory belief lasting almost two years that the contractor and neighbors are colluding to cheat her. She denies hallucinations, thought insertion, disorganized speech, depressive episodes, and manic symptoms.
